major_cooldowns.name: Summon Demonic Tyrant
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it at 5 Soul Shards with 2 or more Demonic Core stacks banked and Dreadstalkers already out, then chain Hand of Gul'dan for the whole window since Tyrant gains 10% damage per active Wild Imp and Dreadstalker.

major_cooldowns.name: Summon Doomguard
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open with it and send it on cooldown thereafter; every Demonic Core you consume cuts 3 sec off its cooldown, so it returns faster through heavy Demonbolt windows.

major_cooldowns.name: Grimoire: Imp Lord
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it on cooldown at the top of the priority, ahead of Grimoire: Fel Ravager and Call Dreadstalkers, so its 20 sec of pet damage feeds the Tyrant setup.

major_cooldowns.name: Grimoire: Fel Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it immediately after Grimoire: Imp Lord and on cooldown thereafter; it also purges one beneficial magic effect from the target.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Siphon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it at 1 or fewer Demonic Core stacks with at least 2 Wild Imps out to convert them into 2 stacks, and again after the second Hand of Gul'dan of the Tyrant window.

defensives.name: Unending Resolve
defensives.usage_rule: Take 25% less damage for 8 sec on predictable raid damage, and use it to keep casting through interrupts, silences and pushback.

defensives.name: Dark Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Trade 20% of current health for a 20 sec shield worth far more before incoming damage; it is usable through control impairing effects.

defensives.name: Mortal Coil
defensives.usage_rule: Emergency 20% maximum health heal that also horrifies the target for 3 sec, so it doubles as an escape from an add on you.

rules.description: Dreadstalkers, then Tyrant, then Hand of Gul'dan
rules.action: Build to 5 Soul Shards with Shadow Bolt, send Call Dreadstalkers, then Summon Demonic Tyrant, then pack the window with as many Hand of Gul'dan casts as you can.

rules.description: Summon Demonic Tyrant at 5 Soul Shards
rules.action: Enter the Tyrant window at 5 Soul Shards and at least 2 Demonic Core stacks so you can chain Hand of Gul'dan without pausing to generate.

rules.description: Call Dreadstalkers before Summon Demonic Tyrant
rules.action: Send Call Dreadstalkers in the two globals before Summon Demonic Tyrant; each active Wild Imp and Dreadstalker adds 10% to Tyrant damage.

rules.description: Demonbolt below the Soul Shard cap
rules.action: Demonbolt generates 2 Soul Shards, so only spend a Demonic Core on it below 4 shards; at 4 or 5 shards cast Hand of Gul'dan first.
Implode at 6 Wild Imps once 3 or more enemies are up, and give the imps a global to land first; single target it is only worth pressing with To Hell and Back.

source_summary: Demonology builds toward Summon Demonic Tyrant on a 1 min cycle, entering the window at 5 Soul Shards and 2 or more Demonic Core stacks with Dreadstalkers and a fresh Wild Imp wave already out, then spending the whole window on Hand of Gul'dan because Tyrant damage recalculates from active summons rather than snapshotting. Grimoire: Imp Lord, Grimoire: Fel Ravager and Summon Doomguard sit above everything else in the priority and open the fight in that order, with Power Siphon topping Demonic Core back up whenever it drops to 1 stack. Implosion enters the priority at 6 Wild Imps on 3 or more targets, or on single target only when To Hell and Back is talented.
